correctness.rationale: The two gate-conditioned backward equations contain the same position reset and unequal switching rates. At the transparent inactive interface, f_I and its derivative agree; at the absorbing active interface, f_A(0-)=1 and f_A(0+)=0. Weighted sum u=beta f_A+alpha f_I and difference v=f_A-f_I decouple into constant-coefficient ODEs with decay rates sqrt(r/D) and sqrt((r+alpha+beta)/D). Boundedness, derivative matching, active jumps and evaluation at the reset point uniquely give B=(k/ell-1)/2, C=r B exp(-ell*x0)/(alpha+beta), and U=-alpha(B+C), hence both conditional side probabilities and their equilibrium mixture. Uniform eventual absorption makes the bounded solution the actual probability. Reparameterization H(a,s)=1-1/a+exp(-a*s)/(a(a+1)) gives H_s<0 and a^2 H_a=1-Q>0 because Q(a,0)<1 and Q_s<0; this proves all strict monotonicity statements and endpoint limits. Symbolic identities and independent finite-difference backward equations verified the constants numerically; finite grids are not treated as infinite proofs. The exact scope and singular-limit qualifications are stated in RESULT.md.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2025 preprint introduced the exact transparent-target, gate-preserving-reset model and displays directional fractions only as simulated data in its comparison section; it does not give the closed conditional left-side formula, stationary mixture, global parameter monotonicity or fast-gating directional limit. Distinct prior works study reflecting gated targets, gated transport interfaces with opposite gate behavior, first-passage-time transforms or generic resetting. The present claim implies no rebranding of first passage time or splitting probability methods. A substantial semantic search of indexed published claims and an accessible own-claim ledger found no comparable left-side formula. Priority remains uncertain because broad mathematical literature may contain equivalent boundary-value results and because the source narrative about a simulated trend has not been reconciled.

value.rationale: The source singles out side-of-absorption probability as a difficult numerical observable and analyzes its dependence on resetting/gating. The exact conditional and stationary laws now give both a fully specified directional observable and global strict monotonicities at all positive physical parameters; the fast-gating value pi_I/2 reveals a singular observable not captured by ordinary FPT-time convergence. This has a concrete interpretation for orientation-resolved reactive hitting or search, and is a natural structural classification of the model rather than a contrived thin parameter slice. No experimental validation or theory beyond the stated point-target setup is asserted.
